answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the copper record and indexed in the saffron history, the raven audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 28 aliases hence needs 28 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
